documents.title: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32

analysis.summary: Prizor Viztech Limited held its H1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting strong revenue and EBITDA growth driven by core surveillance and CCTV product lines. Management highlighted structural industry tailwinds favoring certified 'Make in India' manufacturers following regulatory changes. The company discussed capacity expansion, ongoing R&D in AI-enabled cameras and SoCs, and a recent preferential fundraise to support working capital and future growth. Additionally, management emphasized the expansion of its distribution network and service infrastructure across India. Prizor Viztech reported strong financial and operational progress for H1 FY27, driven by favorable government policies toward Make-in-India products and regulatory compliance.

guidance.claim: Management expects at least 60-70% growth rate on a conservative side for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: So, based on the conservative side, we can say that at least we achieve 60-70% growth rate on a very conservative side that we are pretty much confident on that things, right.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately 60% to 70% growth rate in the coming years.
guidance.quote: So, we think that the growth rate actually we expecting in the next coming few years are approximately this 60-70% at least.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is not an issue as there is a lot of demand in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So basically, demand is not an issue. So, there is a lot of demand there. We have to control and we have to manage the supplies, our procurement raw materials, right.

demand_outlook.claim: The peak season starts from Q3 and reaches its highest in Q4.
demand_outlook.quote: So as of now, the peak season starting from the Q3 and the highest into the Q4, right? So, sales majorly come into the Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: The government's stringent focus on Make-in-India products and regulatory compliance is creating a favorable environment for domestic manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: The government's increasingly stringent focus on Make-in-India products and regulatory compliance is creating a favourable environment for domesticmanufacturerslikeus.

demand_outlook.claim: The global video surveillance market is valued at $35.9 billion in FY25 and is projected to grow at a 10.4% CAGR through FY30.
demand_outlook.quote: The global video surveillance market is valued at $35.9 billion in FY25 and is projected to grow at a 10.4% CAGR through FY30.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry volumes are expected to rise from 1.11 billion to 1.60 billion units over the same period.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry volumes are expected to rise from 1.11 billion to 1.60 billion units over the same period.

capex_expansion.claim: In July, the company commissioned a new assembling line adding 8 lakh units a year and taking capacity from 16 lakhs to 24 lakhs units.
capex_expansion.quote: In July, we commissioned a new assembling line, adding 8 lakh units a year and taking our assembling capacity from 16 lakhs to 24 lakhs unit, an increase of 50%.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a new assembly line, increasing annual capacity by 50% to 24 lakh units.
capex_expansion.quote: A key milestone was the commissioning of our new assembly line, increasing annual capacity by 50% to 24 lakh units, strengthening our readiness for future demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Prizor expanded its geographical footprint by opening new zonal offices in Kolkata and Noida.
capex_expansion.quote: We further expanded our geographical footprint with new Zonal offices in Kolkata and Noida, strengthening our presence across East and North India.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin improved by about 150 basis points to 31.7% from 30.2% in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our gross margin improved by about 150 basis points to 31.7% from 30.2% in H1 FY26, supported by higher in house value addition at Gandhinagar.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 80 basis points to 23.6% ahead of the historical band of 21-23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded by 80 basis points to 23.6% ahead of our historical band of 21-23%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that whatever input cost increases occur, they pass them on to the sale price.
margins_costs.quote: So basically, the our policy into the business is that whatever the input cost we increase, we pass them to our sale price, right.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margins in H2 to be near the same range as H1.
margins_costs.quote: So by and large, into H2 on the going forwards, we think that our margin will near to the same range. Not in a very big difference.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 23.6% in H1 FY27, registering an increase of 80 basis points year-on-year.
EBITDA margin for H2 FY26 was reported at 22.3%.
PAT margin for H2 FY26 was reported at 14.0%.

orders_capacity.claim: Finished camera assembly capacity stands at 24 lakh units at 50% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, our finished camera assembly capacity stands at 24 lakh units.

orders_capacity.claim: Finished camera assembly capacity utilization is nearly 50%.
Scalable assembly capacity is expandable up to 40 lakh units per annum.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised INR 119.45 crore through a preferential issue of equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We have raised INR 119.45 crore through the allotment of about INR 13.63 lakh equity share.

capital_allocation.claim: A preferential allotment of Rs 119.45 crore involving the issuance of 13.63 lakh shares was approved on August 27, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: ROE and ROCE are impacted by the preferential allotment of ₹119.45 crore, involving the issuance of an additional 13.63 lakh shares, approved on 27 August 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: There are challenges in procuring raw materials from global markets due to shortages of flash memory and other items.
risks_headwinds.quote: So still there are challenges into procurement of the raw materials from the global markets because of the shortage of the flash memory and all, right.

management_commitments.claim: Testing and production for the IndieSemic JV is planned to begin by December 2028.
management_commitments.quote: By December ‘28, we will begin testing it and start production as well.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
